faqs.question: How can I book a photography studio session?
faqs.answer: You can book a studio session through phone call, WhatsApp, website booking form, or by visiting the studio directly.

faqs.question: How do I confirm my photography appointment?
faqs.answer: Your booking is confirmed once you receive a confirmation message or email from the studio.

faqs.question: How early should I book a studio session?
faqs.answer: It is recommended to book in advance, especially for weekends, festivals, and wedding seasons.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-in photography sessions?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins may be accepted depending on studio availability, but prior booking is recommended.

faqs.question: Can I reschedule my photography appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can reschedule your session by contacting the studio in advance, subject to availability.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy for studio bookings?
faqs.answer: Cancellations should be made in advance. Refund or reschedule policies depend on studio terms.

faqs.question: What happens if I arrive late for my shoot?
faqs.answer: Late arrival may reduce your shoot time or require rescheduling based on studio schedule.

faqs.question: How long does a photography session take?
faqs.answer: Session duration depends on the package and can range from 30 minutes to several hours.

faqs.question: Can I book a photography session for a group?
faqs.answer: Yes, group bookings are available for families, couples, events, and corporate shoots.

faqs.question: Do you take bookings for events and weddings?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide photography services for weddings, birthdays, corporate events, and special occasions.

faqs.question: Can I request a specific photographer?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can request a preferred photographer based on availability.

faqs.question: How do I check studio availability?
faqs.answer: You can check availability by calling, messaging, or checking the online booking calendar.

faqs.question: Is an advance payment required for booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, most studio bookings require an advance payment to confirm the slot.

faqs.question: Can I choose photography packages during booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can select packages based on your requirements such as portraits, weddings, or events.

faqs.question: Who can I contact for booking support?
faqs.answer: You can contact the studio support team via phone, WhatsApp, or email for any booking assistance.

faqs.question: How are photography studio prices calculated?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the type of shoot, duration, number of photos, editing requirements, and package selected.

faqs.question: What types of photography packages do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer basic shoot packages, premium packages, wedding packages, pre-wedding packages, and customized photography packages.

faqs.question: How much does a studio photoshoot cost?
faqs.answer: Studio photoshoot cost varies based on time duration, backdrop selection, props, and editing services included.

faqs.question: What is included in wedding photography packages?
faqs.answer: Wedding packages may include full event coverage, candid photography, traditional photos, edited images, and albums.

faqs.question: Do you offer pre-wedding photography packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, pre-wedding packages include outdoor or studio shoots with concept planning, outfits, and edited photos.

faqs.question: Can I customize my photography package?
faqs.answer: Yes, packages can be customized based on your budget, event type, and photography requirements.

faqs.question: Do you charge per hour for photography sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes, some packages are hourly based while others are fixed-price depending on the service.

faqs.question: Is photo editing included in the package?
faqs.answer: Yes, basic editing is included in most packages, while advanced editing may be charged separately.

faqs.question: Are photo albums included in photography packages?
faqs.answer: Albums may be included in premium packages or added as an optional service.

faqs.question: Are there any hidden or extra charges?
faqs.answer: All charges are explained before booking, but extra services like additional hours or special editing may cost extra.

faqs.question: Is advance payment required for booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, an advance payment is usually required to confirm photography bookings.

faqs.question: Do you provide discounts on photography packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, seasonal offers, event-based discounts, and combo packages may be available.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellation policies vary depending on the package and notice period provided before the event.

faqs.question: Do you charge extra for outdoor shoots or travel?
faqs.answer: Yes, travel and outdoor shoot locations may include additional charges.

faqs.question: Can I discuss pricing before booking a photography package?
faqs.answer: Yes, consultation is available to help you choose the right package based on your needs and budget.

faqs.question: What types of photoshoot services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer studio photoshoots, outdoor photography, portrait shoots, couple shoots, bridal photoshoots, and event photography.

faqs.question: What is included in a studio photoshoot?
faqs.answer: A studio photoshoot includes professional lighting, backdrop setups, posing guidance, and edited final images.

faqs.question: Do you provide outdoor photography sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer outdoor photoshoots at selected locations based on client preference and availability.

faqs.question: How can I book a photoshoot session?
faqs.answer: You can book a photoshoot via phone call, WhatsApp, or online booking by selecting your preferred package.

faqs.question: How long does a photoshoot session take?
faqs.answer: A photoshoot session usually takes between 1 to 4 hours depending on the package and requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide photo editing services?
faqs.answer: Yes, basic and advanced photo editing services are included in most packages.

faqs.question: How many photos will I receive after the shoot?
faqs.answer: The number of photos depends on the package selected, including both raw and edited images.

faqs.question: Can I change outfits during the photoshoot?
faqs.answer: Yes, outfit changes are allowed depending on the package and session time.

faqs.question: Do you provide props for photoshoots?
faqs.answer: Yes, basic props are available in studio shoots, and custom props can be arranged on request.

faqs.question: Is makeup included in photoshoot packages?
faqs.answer: Some packages include makeup and hairstyling, or they can be added as extra services.

faqs.question: Can I change the photoshoot location after booking?
faqs.answer: Location changes are possible but depend on availability and package terms.

faqs.question: How much does a photoshoot cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the type of shoot, duration, location, and package selected.

faqs.question: When will I receive my photos?
faqs.answer: Edited photos are usually delivered within a few days to a couple of weeks depending on the package.

faqs.question: Do you offer group or family photoshoots?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer family, group, and event photoshoot packages.

faqs.question: Can I discuss ideas before the photoshoot?
faqs.answer: Yes, pre-shoot consultation is available to plan themes, outfits, and styling.

faqs.question: What photography editing services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer photo retouching, color correction, background removal, skin smoothing, album design, and creative editing services.

faqs.question: Do you provide studio photography services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide professional studio photography for portraits, events, products, weddings, and corporate shoots.

faqs.question: How long does photo editing take?
faqs.answer: Editing time depends on the number of photos and complexity, usually ranging from 1 to 5 business days.

faqs.question: How long does delivery of photos take?
faqs.answer: Final delivery is usually completed within 2 to 7 days depending on the project size.

faqs.question: Do you provide urgent or same-day editing?
faqs.answer: Yes, urgent editing services are available for an additional charge based on availability.

faqs.question: In what format will I receive my photos?
faqs.answer: You will receive photos in high-resolution JPEG or PNG formats, and albums in PDF or print-ready formats.

faqs.question: Do you provide raw images after shoot?
faqs.answer: Raw images may be provided upon request, depending on the package selected.

faqs.question: Can I request changes after editing?
faqs.answer: Yes, minor revisions are allowed based on the package terms.

faqs.question: Do you offer album design services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide custom photo album design with creative layouts and themes.

faqs.question: How will my edited photos be delivered?
faqs.answer: Photos are delivered via email, Google Drive, or WhatsApp depending on file size and preference.

faqs.question: Do you provide photo printing services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer high-quality photo printing along with framing and album services.

faqs.question: Will the image quality be high after editing?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ensure high-resolution, professionally enhanced image quality for all edits.

faqs.question: Do you cover event photography?
faqs.answer: Yes, we cover weddings, birthdays, corporate events, and special occasions.

faqs.question: How is photography and editing pricing calculated?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on shoot duration, number of photos, editing complexity, and package selected.

faqs.question: Can I discuss editing requirements before booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, consultation is available to understand your editing style and project needs.
